authorization_changes_from_G0: User explicitly requests five conditions instead of the G0 three conditions; G1 architecture and losses remain unchanged.
Primary is RGC-logit direct-BC intervention error, superseding G0 probability intervention error.
All conditions have 180 optimizer steps and 480 microbatches; A repeats base RGC data to match exposure; E uses independent extra RGC data in those slots.

B uses the same 72 distinct base waveform families and visibility slots as C, with every physical sigma set to 0.30. C assigns 24 distinct families to each training scale. No duplicate common-scale waveform is counted as new data.
RF secondary uses five physical-scale histories and the same prespecified spatial impulse bank, rather than G0 two contrast histories and one central impulse. RF is evaluation only.

stimulus.definition: Gaussian spatial field pixel-area average times mean of four sinusoids; bin-midpoint time samples; known independent zero initial states

data.family_assignment: Each split/pool/logical-scale/row gets a distinct family ID before stimulus or target creation; B is a narrow counterfactual of C sharing the same family, center, phases and random draws. All variants remain within their family split.
data.continuous_noise: iid Gaussian, sampled once and fixed; identical base noise across paired B/C waveforms
data.RGC_noise: causal Bernoulli with teacher-generated strictly-past events; common uniforms for paired B/C
data.training_visibility: Separate H/BC/R files contain only permitted labels; H/BC use zero history. Training never loads teacher/evaluator tensors, development or test.
data.E: 180 base-R batches plus 300 independent extra-R batches. 72 base plus 120 new physical sequences, no heldout-scale labels. Exposure matched, NOT information matched.

optimization.loss: Unmodified G1 observation_loss; H/BC Gaussian sigma=.03; R Bernoulli; equal sequence means of valid scalar means; score bins 60..299; accumulate without division by microbatch count
optimization.joint_schedule: 6-step cycles: H at positions1..5; BC at2..6; R every step. Totals150/150/180. A/E replace H/BC slots with R repeats/extra, each with unchanged R coefficient 1/3.
optimization.progressive_schedule: D steps1..30 H only/tau_h;31..60 BC only/a_h,tau_f,tau_s,alpha;61..180 H+BC each and R once on odd phase step/twice on even; all parameters active. Totals150/150/180.
optimization.C_D_pairing: Identical ordered per-observation streams, data and seed-specific initial states; only timing/freezing differs
optimization.A_E_pairing: Same 180 base-R batches as C/D; 300 supplement slots repeat base data in A, independent extra data in E
optimization.fairness_limit: Equal microbatch/sequence/time exposure is not equal scalar-label count, information, accumulated loss coefficient, FLOPs or backward work. Preserve original coefficients rather than reweight losses.
optimization.selection: final step only; no early stopping, hyperparameter selection, retries from new seeds, restarts to rescue results, additional steps or condition changes
optimization.nonfinite: Stop affected fit and report failure; do not change loss, model or budget

evaluation.primary: Per-sequence RMSE[(ell_block-ell_normal)_student-(ell_block-ell_normal)_teacher], mean sequences within scale then equal mean over heldout scales0.225/0.45
evaluation.history: Same normal teacher sampled event sequence for student/teacher and normal/block; conditional intervention, not free-running spike or biological intervention
evaluation.intervention: BLOCK_DIRECT_BC_DRIVE; whole sequence; tonic gE=1 and BC/AC/history preserved; recompute downstream from V0
secondary_metrics: excess CE with evaluator-only teacher conditional p
relative intervention error with teacher RMS denominator
strata: H@0.15 and BC@0.60 unseen layer-scale combinations
evaluation.ambiguity: Pairwise seed RMS distance of direct-block logit effects, conditional probabilities, H1 h, BC s_B and o_B; reported alongside truth error, not posterior inference
evaluation.test_access: Freeze all15 final checkpoint hashes before first student test evaluation; write TEST_CONSUMED.json before opening test targets; one evaluation, any replay labelled verification of consumed test
evaluation.development: Final descriptive evaluation only; visible observations by original matrix; never used to select models or budgets

rf.role: secondary evaluation only; never a training loss
rf.history: First test common-scale family supplies same center/phases at every history scale; contrast0.4 for bins0..59; zero background thereafter; common all-zero conditioning events
rf.common_probe: Identical bank of 25 square0.10deg apertures at fixed BC-node positions; each independently perturbed +/-0.01 at bin60, pixel-area averaged; same bank under all scale histories
rf.spatial_profile: S=mean_lag(R), normalized by its L2 norm; signed projection onto a fixed uniform temporal vector
rf.temporal_profile: T=mean_position(R), normalized by its L2 norm; signed projection onto a fixed uniform spatial vector
metrics: gain/profile changes relative to common-scale history
rf.limit: Profiles are fixed projections and may cancel; undefined norms are reported, never replaced by a result-selected profile; finite perturbation sensitivity is not a biological RF

verification: Verify frozen G1/dependency/design hashes; run existing G1 unit suite without modifying it
Pre-target protocol/manifest/schedule lock and disjoint waveform families; no duplicate narrow samples counted as distinct
Teacher event sampler probabilities agree with unmodified circuit conditional forward and sampled decisions; teacher frozen
All5x3 fits have exactly180 steps,480 batches; C/D streams and B/C counts match; paired seed initial tensors identical; no forbidden labels in loaded training files
Finite final checkpoints, actual parameter changes, replay saved heldout traces and recompute aggregate CSV/JSON from per-sequence records; test replay explicitly consumed
RF common probe and histories remain frozen; all15 students plus teacher evaluated, no RF loss or result-dependent profile
